svg.title: Position, velocity and acceleration of the jet car with constant acceleration
svg.desc: (a) Position x = 200 + 15t + 2.5t² m curves upward; tangent lines at P (t = 10 s) and Q (t = 25 s) give the velocity. (b) Velocity rises linearly from 15 m/s to 165 m/s, so its slope a is constant. (c) Acceleration is 5.0 m/s² throughout. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.
